_comment: The species the app knows, and what each one hands out. Read by
src/js/species-traits.js, which is the only file that may touch this.
A species is { id, name, traits[] }; a trait is
{ id, level, name, description, unlocks? }.
id          stable, and never derived from position. A default item's id
is its CSV row number and that has bitten this project before
(see the coin purse) - so ids here are written, not counted.
level       optional, defaults to 1. Most species traits arrive at level
1; the few that scale (Draconic Flight, Large Form) say so.
unlocks     optional. Names one or more parts of the character sheet that
stay hidden until this trait is owned - the same key space
class features use, and the same data-unlocked-by markup.
No species uses one today; the support is here because a
user-authored species is expected to.
Order inside a level is the order written here. Descriptions are terse
summaries of the mechanic written for this app - do not paste rulebook
text in.
This file is the shape a user-authored species will take, so keep it data
only: anything that needs logic belongs in species-traits.js. The
character field these match against is `race`, which is what the state
has always called it; the sheet labels it Species.

traits.name: Celestial Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Healing Hands
traits.description: As a Magic action, touch a creature and heal it for a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. Once per long rest.

traits.name: Light Bearer
traits.description: You know the Light cantrip, cast with Charisma.

traits.name: Celestial Revelation
traits.description: As a bonus action, transform for one minute - Heavenly Wings, Inner Radiance or Necrotic Shroud - and add extra damage once per turn while it lasts. Once per long rest.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a kind of dragon. That choice sets the damage type of your Breath Weapon and your resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Replace one attack with a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line of your ancestry's damage type. Dex save for half; the dice grow at 5th, 11th and 17th level. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type of your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: As a bonus action, sprout spectral wings for ten minutes and gain a fly speed equal to your walking speed. Once per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saves against being poisoned.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again at every level after.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a bonus action, gain tremorsense out to 60 feet for ten minutes while on a stone surface. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose Drow, High Elf or Wood Elf. Each grants a cantrip now and a spell at 3rd and 5th level, and Drow widens your Darkvision to 120 feet while Wood Elf raises your speed to 35.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saves to avoid or end the charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: You gain proficiency in Insight, Perception or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You do not sleep. A long rest takes you four hours of light meditation instead of eight.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose Forest Gnome for Minor Illusion and Speak with Animals, or Rock Gnome for Mending, Prestidigitation and a small clockwork device you can build.

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a supernatural boon from your giant forebears - Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone or Storm. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have advantage on saves against being grappled, and count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: As a bonus action, become Large for ten minutes, with advantage on Strength checks and 10 extra feet of speed. Once per long rest.

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saves to avoid or end the frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When a d20 test rolls a 1, reroll it and use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can hide even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: Take the Dash action as a bonus action and gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per short or long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 120 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 hit points without being killed outright, drop to 1 instead. Once per long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic or Infernal. Each grants a damage resistance and a cantrip now, and a spell at 3rd and 5th level.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, cast with the ability your Fiendish Legacy uses.
